The description does not clearly state the chart’s purpose as showing the average MR (%) over three datasets for four parameter amounts, which is the main content indicated by the title and reference.
The description omits that the figure contains exactly four horizontal bars corresponding to the four parameter values and that the bar lengths represent average MR values across three datasets.
